genre.about: the world the image is set in. Context with no genre given is realistic, so a value tagged only fantasy is out of a plain prompt.

era.about: when the image is set. early_modern is roughly 1500-1799. Context with no era given is contemporary.

locale.about: what kind of place around the subject

time_of_day.about: the time of day the scene implies

presentation.about: gendered presentation, only for values that are clearly gendered in images

age.about: the age of the person, only for values that clearly don't fit every age

formality.about: how dressed-up an outfit or place is

budget.about: how expensive a place or outfit looks

region.about: a cultural region, only for values that are culturally specific (a tatami room, a sari)

context.about: Context facets: a value drawn for one detail gives context to the details drawn after it in the same scope (a person, or the whole scene). A list's "context" says which facets its values give and which it takes, and what a mismatch costs: rare multiplies the value's weight by a factor, never sets it to 0. Values with no tag on a facet fit every context.

skin_family.about: broad skin-tone families, from fair to deep; on a descent value, the families typical of that heritage, for drawing

eye_family.about: broad natural eye-color families: brown, hazel or amber, and light (blue, gray, green); on a descent value, the families typical of that heritage, for drawing

hair_family.about: broad natural hair-color families; gray, white and dyed colors are untagged and fit everyone. On a descent value, the families typical of that heritage, for drawing

texture.about: natural hair texture (the hair list's own texture tags); on a descent value, the textures typical of that heritage, for drawing

time_of_day.about: the time of day (the facet of the same name)

space.about: indoors or outdoors (the facet of the same name)

climate.about: the temperature the scene implies (the facet of the same name)

life_stage.about: the stage of life a person's drawn age is in; on a face value, the stages it is seen at (deep lines from middle age, baby-round cheeks on a child). Values with no tag fit every age.
